description:
Last year platform duploc.com celebrated its fifth anniversary with a 15-track compilation release, while behind the scenes two cuts from the "5 Years of duploc.com album" did each get the remix treatment. DUPLOC025 marks that special milestone edition through which the two label-exclusive dubplates are finally being revealed. 

"Extinction" is considered to be one of ARtroniks' leading productions as ENiGMA Dubz fuels the fire by immersing the original percussion-heavy foundations in his own naughty sound. On the digital flip side ARtroniks returns the favor with his powerful remix of "Dirty South". This is the result of putting two DUPLOC residents together on one single project.
